# `dlq.batch_size`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of messages the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `256` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | dlq |
| Unit | messages |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `dlq.batch_size` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[dlq]
batch_size = 256
```

# `scheduler.batch_size`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `500` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | scheduler |
| Unit | messages |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `scheduler.batch_size` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
batch_size = 500
```
